zh: 别担心，下次再努力。
old_en: Don't worry, take your time, and try harder next time.
new_en: Don't worry, try harder next time.

zh: 这次没赶上没关系，还有下次机会。
old_en: Don't worry, there's still another chance next time.
new_en: Don't worry, you'll have another chance next time.

zh: 打碎杯子没关系，去买个新的。
old_en: Don't worry, just buy a new one next time.
new_en: Don't worry, just buy a new one.

zh: 别担心，这次面试没通过还有下次。
old_en: Don't worry, there's another interview next time.
new_en: Don't worry, there's another interview next time.

zh: 这次的报告没做好没关系，下次改进就好。
old_en: Don't worry, just improve for next time.
new_en: Don't worry, just improve next time.

zh: 新手刚开始，慢慢来就行。
old_en: Don't worry, just take your time as a beginner.
new_en: Don't worry, take your time as a beginner.

zh: 丢了书包别担心，先去吃饭。
old_en: Don't worry, have your meal first.
new_en: Don't worry, have your meal first.

zh: 书包没找着没关系，先别着急。
old_en: No worries, you can take your time to find it.
new_en: Don't worry, take your time to find it.

zh: 不用急着回复，慢慢来。
old_en: Don't rush, take your time to reply.
new_en: Don't rush, take your time to reply.

zh: 别担心，晚上再发也行。
old_en: It's okay, you can send it later at night.
new_en: Don't worry, you can send it later tonight.

zh: 第一次上台讲话别担心，慢慢来就好。
old_en: Don't worry, take your time for the first speech.
new_en: Don't worry, take your time for the first speech.

zh: 第一次演讲紧张正常，慢慢来别着急。
old_en: Don't worry, it's normal to be nervous, just take your time.
new_en: Don't worry, it's normal to be nervous, just take it slow.

zh: 别担心，孩子还小，慢慢来。
old_en: Don't worry, kids learn at their own pace.
new_en: Don't worry, kids learn at their own pace.

zh: 他把房间弄得乱七八糟没关系，慢慢收拾。
old_en: It's okay, we can clean up the room gradually.
new_en: It's okay, we can clean up the room gradually.

zh: 费用的事别担心，我们可以一起想办法。
old_en: Don't worry about the costs, we can figure it out together.
new_en: Don't worry about the costs, we can figure it out together.

zh: 费用的事别着急，我们慢慢来就行。
old_en: Don't worry, we can take our time with it.
new_en: Don't worry, we can take our time with it.

zh: 这次考试没做好没关系，下次再努力。
old_en: It's okay, just work harder next time for the exam.
new_en: It's okay, just try harder next time.

zh: 你刚刚没听清楚没关系，我再说一遍。
old_en: No worries, I'll repeat what I said if you didn't hear it clearly.
new_en: No worries, I'll say it again if you didn't hear it clearly.

zh: 朋友迟到了没关系，这次晚一点也行。
old_en: It's okay; he might have hit traffic.
new_en: It's okay, it's fine if your friend is late this time.

zh: 他迟到了别担心，可能是路上堵车。
old_en: Don't worry, it might be because of the traffic jam.
new_en: Don't worry, he might be stuck in traffic.
